definition: [ חָדַשׁ ] verb only Pi`el (and Hithpa`el ) renew, repair (in poetry and late) (Late Hebrew id. , Phoenician חדש ; noun חדש new moon , also in קרתחדשת new-city = Carthage ; Aramaic and חַדֵּשׁ ; Arabic be new , Ethiopic 1. 2. renew ; Sabean החדתֿ , see Os ( Levy ):ZMG 1865, 204 Mordt ZMG 1876, 30 ; Assyrian [adâšu], uddiš, renew, eššu , new , etc. Dl W 199 ff. ) — Pi`el Perfect וְחִדְּשׁוּ consecutive Isa 61:4 Imperfect וַיְחַדֵּשׁ 2Chr 15:8 2 masculine singular תְּחַדֵּשׁ Job 10:17 ; Ps 104:30 וּנְחַדֵּשׁ 1Sam 11:14 Imperative חַדֵּשׁ Ps 51:21 Infinitive לְחַדֵּשׁ 2Chr 24:4 ; 2Chr 24:12 — 1. renew, make anew הַמְּלוּכָה 1Sam 11:14 (editorial); פני אדמה Ps 104:30 , רוּחַ Ps 51:12 (|| בּרא ); = bring back יָמֵינוּ כְּקֶדֶם Lam 5:21 עדיך ׳ ח Job 10:17 i.e. bringest fresh (new) witnesses. 2. repair , cities Isa 61:4 , temple 2Chr 24:4 ; 2Chr 24:12 , altar 2Chr 15:8 . Hithpa`el Imperfect 3 feminine singular תִּתְחַדֵּשׁ with plural subject כַּנֶּשֶׁר נְעוּרָ֑יְכִת ׳ ת Ps 103:5 thy youth reneweth itself, like the eagle.
